title: Module 8: Emerging Technologies in Learning
description: Analyzing the impact of Artificial Intelligence Tutors, Large Language Models (LLMs), and VR/AR on the future architecture of learning.
learning_objectives: Evaluate where AI tutors, LLMs, and immersive media fit in instructional ecosystems.
Identify the instructional opportunities and risks of emerging learning technologies.
Design a future-facing learning workflow that still preserves pedagogy, ethics, and human support.
